name: Gideon, Champion of Justice — "becomes a Human Soldier creature with power and toughness each equal to the number of loyalty counters on him"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). Fired, the 0 ability only gave indestructible: Gideon stayed a planeswalker with no power or toughness. The number is locked in as the ability resolves, so the fired text is rewritten to "becomes a 5/5 Human Soldier creature" from the loyalty counters on Gideon at that moment. Two counters added afterwards do not change it.
